title: This is the exact training split I’m using to build muscle at 49.
hook: This is the exact training split I’m using to build muscle at 49.
caption:
This is the exact training split I’m using to build muscle at 49.

One of the questions I get asked most is, “What’s your workout routine?”

So here it is.

I train six days a week using a push, pull, legs split, hitting each muscle group twice every week.

Why?

Because it’s a structure that works for me.

It allows me to train consistently, recover well and progressively get stronger over time.

I don’t believe there’s one “perfect” programme.

What matters most is finding a routine you enjoy and can stick to.

My focus is simple:

🏋️ Train with good technique.

📈 Progressively overload.

💪
